reconciliation.note: The v1.2 baseline (28764) was the UNMINIFIED full-barrel gzip. It is reproduced here for continuity. The §14 profile numbers above are MINIFIED and are the honest download figures.

serverClientBoundary.finding: The server serializer chain (ServerDOMAdapter → serializeServerNode → escapeHtmlText/escapeHtmlAttr/VOID_ELEMENTS) was leaking into client bundles that never import SSR. Root cause: the top-level convenience singletons `export const serverDOMAdapter = new ServerDOMAdapter()` and `browserDOMAdapter = new BrowserDOMAdapter()` were NOT annotated, so esbuild treated the `new` as an import-time side effect and retained the classes + their serialize methods everywhere. This was a PRE-EXISTING leak (present in v1.3), enlarged ~100B by the §13/§14 escape optimization.
serverClientBoundary.fix: Annotated both singleton instantiations `/* @__PURE__ */ new X()` in packages/dom/src/{server-adapter,browser-adapter}.ts. The exports remain (frozen public API preserved, additive-only, nothing removed); only their unused initializers are now droppable, letting the server serializer tree-shake OUT of non-SSR client bundles.
serverClientBoundary.verification: A minimal `import { signal } from "streetui"` bundle no longer contains """/"&"/VOID tag list/"<!--" serializer strings (grep-confirmed post-fix). full profile (import *) legitimately RETAINS SSR via renderToString and is unaffected by the tree-shake, so it reflects the +~100B §13/§14 serializer code as disclosed.
serverClientBoundary.invariantsPreserved: build 29/29, typecheck 47/47, tests 657 pass; all 5 SSR route bodies still sha256-identical; frozen v1.0 API (168 values/171 types) intact — exports unchanged.

comparisonVsV13.note: gzip minified JS, v1.3 bundle.json → v1.4 (this file). Negative = smaller client bundle. minimal/typical/realApp shrink because the server serializer now tree-shakes out; full grows slightly because import * retains SSR and carries the §13/§14 serializer code.
